Backend: new pytest test_round1_calls.py 12/12 pass (week counts vs status_history, seeded sessions ended, real-first sort, /api/calls list+detail, signed recording link 200/403, Vapi end-of-call-report after portal end saves transcript/recording/summary/vapi_call_id without re-running end_call, recording copied to storage within ~6s, sample leads never matched, take over -> escalated + session.takeover + takeover_alert WhatsApp body exact (simulated) + outcome 'Taken over by contractor', queue_quote_followup site_visit_requested -> followups/lead/dashboard visits + outcome 'Visit requested', POST /leads/{id}/visit -> visit_scheduled message exact + visit_scheduled_for). Regression test_call_fixes/test_itemizer/test_itemizer_fixes/test_media_percia serial: 70 passed, 1 deselected (fix7 Gemini). Frontend (Playwright, Mongo session cookie): week-line + 5 buttons filter/clear table, old tiles gone, visit-section row/time/schedule/call works and shows visit-scheduled, 'Visit requested' status filter works, drawer call-card with audio (signed link fetch 200 audio/x-wav), scrollable Homeowner/Alex transcript, outcome, findings empty state, take-over-btn only on truly live lead (not on Maya/ended), Take over click shows takeover-prompt with tel: link, sidebar Sessions -> /sessions with rows + detail panel, Quotes still shows 'coming next' toast. Two issues with seeded sample data found (see below).

minor.issue: Seeded sessions are ended by setting ended_at=now() at backend startup, so session-lead-maya shows duration '895m 38s' (~15 h) on Sessions page and outcome 'Quote given' because the quote window becomes huge. Should set ended_at = started_at + realistic duration (e.g. 5-8 min), also in core/seed.py so /dev/reset doesn't recreate open sessions.
'Visit requested' check uses followups at >= started_at with no upper bound (ended_at), so a visit request from a later call relabels all earlier calls of that lead.

vapi_call_id is never stored at call start (portal /call/start doesn't receive Vapi call.id), so the first report always falls back to the lead's latest session; if a homeowner starts a second call before the first report arrives, the report attaches to the wrong session. Consider passing call.id from vapiAdapter on call-start to the backend.
asyncio.create_task(copy_recording(...)) without holding a reference; task may be garbage-collected. Keep a set of background tasks.
N+1 query: one call_sessions.find_one per lead for last_call_id. Fine at current scale.

ui_bugs.issue: Maya has no live session (live=null, no take-over/on-call card in drawer - correct) but the leads table still shows 'On call now', 'Building...' and a 'Watch' action because LeadRow keys off status==walkthru_initiated instead of lead.live. Contradicts 'Maya shows no live card/timer'. Use lead.live for these cells or move seeded Maya to walkthru_completed.
